name: Chestnuts
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated for SIBO patients as they are low FODMAP and contain less fiber than many other nuts.
preparationTips: Score an X on flat side before roasting to prevent bursting
Roast at 425°F for 15-20 minutes until tender
Can be boiled for 15-20 minutes as alternative to roasting
Remove both outer shell and inner skin while still warm
nutritionalHighlights: Lower in fat than most nuts, higher in carbohydrates
